# `lakana column-mask`

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana column-mask [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Manage column masks.

## `lakana column-mask create`

Usage: `lakana column-mask create [OPTIONS] {table} {column}`

Mask COLUMN of TABLE (namespace.table) for a principal or group.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TABLE` | text | required |  |
| `COLUMN` | text | required |  |
| `--expression` | text | required | Restricted SQL expression. |
| `--principal` | text | none | Principal name. |
| `--group` | text | none | Group name. |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--override-managed` | flag | off | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency (needs ADMIN on the instance; audited; the next apply reverts it). |
| `--reason` | text | none | Why, 10-500 characters on one line (with --override-managed). |

## `lakana column-mask list`

Usage: `lakana column-mask list [OPTIONS]`

List active column masks, optionally filtered.

The table names who each column mask is for in `subject`. When the terminal is too narrow it leaves out `environment`, `id`, `namespace` and `bound`, in that order; `--output json` always has every field.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--principal` | text | none | Principal name. |
| `--group` | text | none | Group name. |
| `--env` | text | none | Only this environment. |

## `lakana column-mask revoke`

Usage: `lakana column-mask revoke [OPTIONS] {column_mask_id}`

Revoke column mask COLUMN_MASK_ID.

Take the id from `column-mask list`; on a narrow terminal the table leaves it out, so widen the terminal or use `--output json`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COLUMN_MASK_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--yes` | flag | off | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--override-managed` | flag | off | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency (needs ADMIN on the instance; audited; the next apply reverts it). |
| `--reason` | text | none | Why, 10-500 characters on one line (with --override-managed). |
